sys_ui_page.description: Smart Manufacturing mobile dashboard (live data via smart_mfg_api)
sys_ui_page.html:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
<g2:evaluate var="jvar_smm_ck">gs.getSession().getSessionToken();</g2:evaluate>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no" />
  <title>ServiceNow • Smart Manufacturing</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="anonymous" />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #f3f6fb;
      --card: #ffffff;
      --navy-900: #071224;
      --navy-800: #0b1a33;
      --navy-700: #12284b;
      --ink: #0f1b2d;
      --ink-2: #44546a;
      --ink-3: #7a889b;
      --line: #e3e9f2;
      --line-2: #eef2f8;
      --ok: #10b981;      --ok-ink: #047857;      --ok-bg: #e7f8f1;
      --warn: #f59e0b;    --warn-ink: #b45309;    --warn-bg: #fef4e2;
      --bad: #ef4444;     --bad-ink: #b91c1c;     --bad-bg: #fdecec;
      --info: #2563eb;    --info-ink: #1d4ed8;    --info-bg: #e8f0fe;
      --ai: #7c3aed;      --ai-ink: #6d28d9;      --ai-bg: #f1eafe;
      --mute-bg: #eef2f7;
      --r-lg: 20px; --r-md: 16px; --r-sm: 12px;
      --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,27,45,0.04), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(15,27,45,0.12);
      --font-sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
    body {
      background: #060d1a;
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      color: var(--ink);
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: flex-start;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    button, input, select { font-family: inherit; }
    svg.ic { display: inline-block; vertical-align: middle; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

    /* ---------- shell ---------- */
    .phone-container { max-width: 440px; width: 100%; min-height: 100vh; background: var(--bg); position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
    .app-header {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-900) 0%, var(--navy-800) 55%, var(--navy-700) 100%);
      color: #fff; padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -10px rgba(7,18,36,0.7);
    }
    .header-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
    .header-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .brand-mark { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 9px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #34d399, #2563eb); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.14) inset; flex: none; }
    .header-title-box { min-width: 0; }
    .header-title-box h1 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .header-sub { font-size: 10px; color: #8fa6c7; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
    .live-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #34d399; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(52,211,153,0.6); animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
    @keyframes pulse { 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(52,211,153,0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(52,211,153,0); } }
    .icon-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #cfe0f7; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; flex: none; }
    .icon-btn.spin svg { animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    .user-avatar { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 11px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8, #7c3aed); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; }
    .content-area { flex: 1; padding: 14px 14px 96px; }
    .screen-view { display: none; }
    .screen-view.active { display: block; animation: viewIn 0.24s ease-out; }
    @keyframes viewIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
    .state-box { text-align: center; padding: 70px 20px; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 13px; }

    .bottom-nav {
      position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); max-width: 440px; width: 100%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); padding: 8px 6px 12px; z-index: 200;
    }
    .nav-item { background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--ink-3); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; gap: 3px; position: relative; padding-top: 4px; }
    .nav-item .nav-ic { width: 44px; height: 28px; border-radius: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; }
    .nav-item.active { color: var(--info-ink); }
    .nav-item.active .nav-ic { background: var(--info-bg); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(37,99,235,0.12), 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(37,99,235,0.55); }
    .nav-badge { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; margin-left: 8px; background: var(--bad); color: #fff; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 5px; border: 2px solid #fff; }

    .toast-popup {
      position: fixed; top: 64px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-20px); background: var(--navy-800); color: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(96,165,250,0.5); padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 14px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -10px rgba(7,18,36,0.6); opacity: 0; transition: 0.3s; pointer-events: none; z-index: 999; max-width: 400px; width: max-content; text-align: center;
    }
    .toast-popup.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
    .toast-popup.error { border-color: var(--bad); }

    /* ---------- primitives ---------- */
    .card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .card.tap { cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s; }
    .card.tap:active { transform: scale(0.985); }
    .sec-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin: 18px 2px 8px; }
    .sec-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
    .sec-link { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--info-ink); cursor: pointer; }
    .sec-note { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-3); }
    .eyebrow { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); }
    .t-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
    .t-sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
    .t-mute { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-3); }
    .row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
    .row-l { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
    .grow { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .cut { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

    .chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
    .chip i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; flex: none; }
    .chip-ok { background: var(--ok-bg); color: var(--ok-ink); }
    .chip-warn { background: var(--warn-bg); color: var(--warn-ink); }
    .chip-bad { background: var(--bad-bg); color: var(--bad-ink); }
    .chip-info { background: var(--info-bg); color: var(--info-ink); }
    .chip-ai { background: var(--ai-bg); color: var(--ai-ink); }
    .chip-mute { background: var(--mute-bg); color: var(--ink-2); }

    .ic-box { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; }
    .ib-ok { background: var(--ok-bg); color: var(--ok-ink); }
    .ib-warn { background: var(--warn-bg); color: var(--warn-ink); }
    .ib-bad { background: var(--bad-bg); color: var(--bad-ink); }
    .ib-info { background: var(--info-bg); color: var(--info-ink); }
    .ib-ai { background: var(--ai-bg); color: var(--ai-ink); }
    .ib-mute { background: var(--mute-bg); color: var(--ink-2); }

    .progress-track { background: #e6ecf5; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; margin: 8px 0; }
    .progress-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--ok); border-radius: 999px; transform-origin: left; animation: grow 0.7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
    @keyframes grow { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } }
    .stack { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: #e6ecf5; margin-top: 8px; }
    .stack span { display: block; height: 100%; }

    .ring { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; }
    .ring svg { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
    .ring circle { fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .ring-in { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; line-height: 1.1; }

    .btn { border: none; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 13px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12.5px; color: #fff; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; transition: transform 0.1s, opacity 0.2s; }
    .btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
    .btn[disabled] { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }
    .btn-blue { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(37,99,235,0.7); }
    .btn-green { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #059669); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(16,185,129,0.7); }
    .btn-amber { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #d97706); }
    .btn-ai { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #2563eb); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -8px rgba(124,58,237,0.75); }
    .btn-outline { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #c9d6ea; color: var(--info-ink); }
    .btn-outline-green { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #a7e3cd; color: var(--ok-ink); }
    .btn-soft { background: var(--mute-bg); color: var(--ink); }
    .btn-sm { padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 11px; border-radius: 10px; }
    .btn-block { width: 100%; }
    .btn-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; align-items: center; }
    .btn-row .btn { flex: 1; }

    .segmented-control { display: flex; background: #e6ecf5; padding: 3px; border-radius: 13px; gap: 3px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .seg-btn { flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 7px 4px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; }
    .seg-btn.active { background: #fff; color: var(--info-ink); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(15,27,45,0.12); }
    .field-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); }
    .field-select, .field-static, .field-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #d5deeb; border-radius: 12px; margin: 5px 0 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); outline: none; }
    .field-input:focus, .field-select:focus { border-color: var(--info); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,0.14); }
    .field-static { background: #f7f9fc; }
    .search-box { position: relative; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .search-box svg { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 11px; color: var(--ink-3); }
    .search-box input { margin: 0; padding-left: 36px; }
    .qty-input { width: 62px; padding: 10px 6px; border: 1px solid #d5deeb; border-radius: 12px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; text-align: center; flex: none; }
    .empty-note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); text-align: center; padding: 8px 0; }

    .issue-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-2); gap: 8px; }
    .issue-item:first-child { padding-top: 0; }
    .issue-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }
    .issue-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
    .dot-icon { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; }
    .dot-red { background: var(--bad); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--bad-bg); }
    .dot-amber { background: var(--warn); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--warn-bg); }
    .dot-yellow { background: #eab308; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fdf6d3; }
    .dot-blue { background: var(--info); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--info-bg); }
    .issue-name { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; }
    .issue-desc { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-3); }

    .pastel-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .pastel-tile { border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px 8px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(15,27,45,0.04); }
    .pastel-tile .num { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
    .pastel-tile .lbl { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px; opacity: 0.9; }

    /* ---------- dashboard ---------- */
    .greet { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; margin: 2px 2px 12px; }
    .greet h2 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
    .hero {
      border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; color: #fff; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
      background: radial-gradient(120% 140% at 0% 0%, #1b3a6b 0%, rgba(27,58,107,0) 55%), radial-gradient(90% 120% at 100% 100%, rgba(124,58,237,0.35) 0%, rgba(124,58,237,0) 60%), linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-900), var(--navy-700));
      box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -18px rgba(7,18,36,0.75);
    }
    .hero .eyebrow { color: #8fa6c7; }
    .hero-top { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; }
    .hero-big { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; }
    .hero-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 78px 1fr 44px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 10.5px; color: #b8c9e3; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 6px; }
    .hero-row b { color: #fff; text-align: right; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; }
    .hero-bar { height: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); overflow: hidden; }
    .hero-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; transform-origin: left; animation: grow 0.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
    .glass { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; margin-top: 14px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
    .lights { display: flex; gap: 5px; margin-top: 8px; }
    .lights span { flex: 1; height: 18px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; }
    .kpi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .kpi { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); cursor: pointer; }
    .kpi-val { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-top: 8px; line-height: 1.1; }
    .kpi-val small { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-3); }
    .cols { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; height: 64px; margin-top: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .cols span { flex: 1; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; min-height: 3px; cursor: pointer; transform-origin: bottom; animation: rise 0.7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
    @keyframes rise { from { transform: scaleY(0); } to { transform: scaleY(1); } }
    .legend { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 600; margin-top: 8px; }
    .legend i { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 3px; margin-right: 5px; vertical-align: baseline; }

    .ai-card { border-radius: 22px; padding: 1.5px; margin-bottom: 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #2563eb 55%, #34d399); box-shadow: 0 16px 30px -18px rgba(124,58,237,0.7); }
    .ai-in { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbfaff, #f5f8ff); border-radius: 20.5px; padding: 14px; }
    .ai-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ai-ink); }
    .ai-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 8px 0 2px; }
    .metric-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin: 12px 0; }
    .metric { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 13px; padding: 9px 6px; text-align: center; }
    .metric b { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
    .metric span { font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 700; }

    /* ---------- production ---------- */
    .chips-scroll { display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-bottom: 2px; }
    .fchip { border: 1px solid #d5deeb; background: #fff; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 11px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }
    .fchip.active { background: var(--navy-800); border-color: var(--navy-800); color: #fff; }
    .meta-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px 12px; margin-top: 10px; }
    .meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-2); min-width: 0; }
    .meta svg { color: var(--ink-3); }
    .meta b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
    .fab-btn { position: fixed; bottom: 86px; right: max(16px, calc(50% - 204px)); width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #7c3aed); color: #fff; border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 12px 22px -8px rgba(37,99,235,0.7); cursor: pointer; z-index: 150; }
    .gantt { overflow-x: auto; }
    .gantt-in { min-width: 520px; padding-bottom: 4px; }
    .g-axis, .g-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 104px 1fr; align-items: center; }
    .g-axis { font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .g-scale { position: relative; height: 14px; }
    .g-scale span { position: absolute; transform: translateX(-50%); white-space: nowrap; }
    .g-group { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); margin: 10px 0 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .g-row { height: 22px; cursor: pointer; }
    .g-lbl { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--font-mono); }
    .g-lane { position: relative; height: 12px; }
    .g-win { position: absolute; top: 0; height: 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #dbe5f3; overflow: hidden; }
    .g-win span { display: block; height: 100%; }
    .g-over { position: absolute; top: 3px; height: 6px; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b 0, #f59e0b 4px, #fde3ae 4px, #fde3ae 8px); }
    .g-eta { position: absolute; top: 2px; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-left: -4px; transform: rotate(45deg); background: var(--ink); border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 2px; box-sizing: content-box; }
    .g-now { position: absolute; top: -4px; bottom: -4px; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--bad); border-radius: 2px; }

    /* ---------- detail ---------- */
    .detail-hero { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; }
    .stepper { position: relative; padding-left: 22px; }
    .stepper:before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 7px; top: 14px; bottom: 14px; width: 2px; background: var(--line); }
    .step { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; }
    .step:before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -22px; top: 50%; margin-top: -8px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; border: 2px solid #c9d6ea; }
    .step.done:before { background: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ok-bg); }
    .step.now:before { border-color: var(--warn); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--warn-bg); }
    .step.bad:before { background: var(--bad); border-color: var(--bad); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--bad-bg); }

    .cmp { margin-top: 6px; }

    .node { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }

    .link-v { width: 2px; height: 18px; margin: 0 auto; background: #c9d6ea; position: relative; }
    .link-v:after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -3px; bottom: -2px; border: 4px solid transparent; border-top-color: #9fb2cc; border-bottom: 0; }
    .comp { border-top: 1px solid var(--line-2); padding: 9px 0; }
    .hop { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 14px 1fr 14px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: 6px; }
